scripts.build: turbo run build && pnpm run bundle:openkit
scripts.check:repo: node scripts/validate-spec-lifecycle.mjs && node scripts/validate-story-schema.mjs && node scripts/validate-doc-model.mjs && node scripts/generate-doc-index.mjs --check && node scripts/validate-agent-interface-reachability.mjs && biome check . && pnpm --filter @openkit/models-dev-catalog test
scripts.test:unit: turbo run test && pnpm run build:openkit && git diff --exit-code -- skills/openkit/scripts/openkit && node --test tests/*.test.mjs tests/story-runner/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:smoke: pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore build && node tests/smoke/nanocore-health-smoke.mjs && pnpm --filter @openkit/web build && node tests/smoke/web-preview-smoke.mjs
scripts.test:stories:a1-restart:preflight: pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore... build && pnpm --filter @openkit/core-client... build && bash -n apps/nanocore/scripts/openshell-cell.sh && node --test --test-name-pattern="streams A1 auth|partial account file|hung SSH auth stream" tests/story-runner/real-codex-support.test.mjs && node --test tests/story-runner/a1-nanocore-restart-runner.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @openkit/nanocore exec vitest run src/runtime/openshell-cell.test.ts
scripts.verify:l0-l2: pnpm run check:repo && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:coverage && pnpm build
scripts.verify:release: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:smoke
scripts.verify:full: pnpm run verify:l0-l2 && pnpm run test:e2e:nano && pnpm run test:e2e:web && pnpm run test:smoke && pnpm run test:stories
